triage_rationale: Brownfield codebase: 2 HTML entry points (index.html for siswa, penjual.html for penjual) + 1 serverless API handler (api/orders.js) = 4 core source files. STANDARD tier justified by: non-trivial blast radius between seller dashboard and student ordering flows sharing the /api/orders contract, cross-tab sync via localStorage + 1.5s polling, order status lifecycle state machine touching both pages, and design improvisation requirement adding UI risk.
framework: Vanilla HTML + JS (no framework) — Tailwind CSS CDN, qrcode.js 1.0.0 CDN, deployed on Vercel as serverless functions with cleanUrls

architectural_patterns.state_management: localStorage (kantin_orders, kantin_counter, kantin_last_order_id) with globalThis in-memory fallback on serverless cold start
architectural_patterns.data_fetching: Fetch API to /api/orders (Vercel serverless) with 1.5s polling interval + localStorage fallback for offline mode
architectural_patterns.routing: Static multi-page (index.html for siswa, penjual.html for penjual) via Vercel cleanUrls — no client-side router
architectural_patterns.styling_engine: Tailwind CSS via CDN script tag (tailwindcss CDN), no build step
architectural_patterns.orm_database: Upstash Redis (^1.34.0, optional) + globalThis in-memory array fallback
architectural_patterns.order_lifecycle: State machine: Dipesan → Diterima → Disiapkan → Siap Diambil → Selesai
architectural_patterns.deployment: Vercel serverless functions (api/orders.js) with vercel.json cleanUrls: true

dependent_consumers: index.html (fetch('/api/orders') for GET all orders, POST new order, PATCH status, 1.5s polling)
penjual.html (fetch('/api/orders') for GET all orders, PATCH status, DELETE clear, filter/stats computation)
QRCode div (#qrcode) in index.html success section

dependencies.build_toolchain: None — pure static HTML served by Vercel
